## Which file do I need?

| You want to… | Download |
|---|---|
| Play straight away on any computer | **cognitive-terrain-0.17.4.html**, then double-click it to open in your browser |
| Read the rules | **Cognitive-Terrain-Field-Manual-0.17.4.pdf** |
| A one-sheet summary to print, two-sided | **Cognitive-Terrain-Player-Aid-0.17.4.pdf** |
| Run it for a group, build campaigns, see why it works | **Cognitive-Terrain-Practitioners-Manual-0.17.4.pdf** |
| Hear each week read aloud (optional) | the **Immersive Briefings** voice pack, on its own release: **voice-emma-1** |
| Install it like a normal program | **…-Setup.exe** (Windows), **…-macOS-AppleSilicon.zip** or **…-macOS-Intel.zip** (Mac), **…-Linux.tar.gz** |
| Host it on itch.io | **…-web.zip** |

The installers are not code-signed yet, so Windows and macOS warn on first
launch. **PLAYTEST-README.txt** explains how to get past the warning.

Two-player games work between any of these files, as long as both players
use version 0.17.4.

## What's new

- **A clearer move preview.** Hover a node with a card picked and the card
  now shows how far the move pushes it as one big number, who the node leans
  toward now and after the move on a red and blue bar (with a gold arrow
  between), a verdict such as "Gets a foothold", arrows for what helps or
  hurts, and the odds in words: Almost guaranteed, Likely, Risky or Long shot,
  with the chance to fail. The words describe the game's dice, not real-world
  odds.
  - **Show the numbers** in Settings adds the arithmetic under the preview.
  - The push shown is for the usual audience the move would reach, so a
    watched node now shows how much weaker an attack there usually is. The
    side panel shows the same usual figure.
  - Each move's result and full story, with the research formula, are
    unchanged.
- **Numbers that add up.** A node's lean is now rounded the same way
  everywhere, and the push in a move's preview and result is the change you
  see on the map. A push of 22.5 from Olvana 100 now reads +23 and Olvana 77;
  before, the map rounded 77.5 the other way and showed Olvana 78. How the
  game plays is unchanged.
- The Field Manual's move and push pages show the new preview.
- No rule changes. Two-player codes work between 0.17 builds.
